examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{小屋|こや}に{泊|と}まった。
examples.english: I stayed at a mountain hut.

examples.japanese: {鶏|にわとり}{小屋|ごや}から{卵|たまご}を{取|と}ってきた。
examples.english: I brought eggs from the chicken coop.
examples.notes: [Note: Reading changes to ごや in compounds]

examples.japanese: {物置|ものおき}{小屋|こや}を{建|た}てた。

notes:
{小屋|こや} is a small building or shelter.

TYPES OF SMALL BUILDINGS:
- {山|やま}{小屋|ごや} (mountain hut)
- {物置|ものおき}{小屋|こや} (storage shed)
- {犬|いぬ}{小屋|ごや} (doghouse)
- {鶏|にわとり}{小屋|ごや} (chicken coop)
- {掘|ほ}っ{立|た}て{小屋|ごや} (shack, shanty)

NOTE ON READING:
- Standalone: こや
- In compounds: often ごや (rendaku)

HISTORICAL USE:
- {芝居|しばい}{小屋|ごや} (theater, playhouse - historical)
- {見世物|みせもの}{小屋|ごや} (sideshow tent - historical)
